## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

Oncology

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

Biopharma

### Scientifically rigorous, extensive in scale

Our global lab footprint, vast clinical data and scientific expertise help accelerate the drug
development process.

[ Learn More ][222]
[Labcorp biopharma technician evaluating samples]

### Stop wondering. Go test yourself.

Explore over 50 self-ordered lab tests and get answers about your health.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[Roche publishes its first quarter results for 2026][103]

Roche reports 7% (CER) sales for the full year results in 2025. Commenting on the results, CEO
Thomas Schinecker said: “2025 was a strong year for Roche, reflecting our continued focus on
operational and R&D excellence.”

positive change for patients, the people they love and the professionals who care for them. Discover
the highlights in our Annual Report.

eSources is the UK's fastest growing **wholesale** [trade directory][148]. Our services will help
you source wholesale merchandise from **UK suppliers** faster than ever before.

Basic wholesale buyer membership is free, with the option of [upgrading to premium buyer
services][149] to access all listed supplier and wholesaler details. If you are a UK wholesale
supplier you can [list your business details free][150] and upgrade to premium services, which
include a number of trade tools that will increase your company's exposure to wholesale buyers
worldwide.

Thousands of trade buyers and wholesale UK suppliers are [joining eSources][151] every month, be
part of this growing trend and start profiting from our services.

#### For Trade Suppliers
* Are you a wholesaler or trade supplier? **Request a free listing** on eSources

* List products, receive orders, and reply to buy leads.

* List your company profile in up to 5 categories and target each profile to each category.

#### Resources

* Read [trade related articles][155] and enhance your sales skills.
* Research the selling potential of any product using the free eSources [Market Research

#### New Wholesale Products

#### Register on eSources as a buyer, premium supplier or international supplier:

As a **B2B trade portal** we offer 4 registration options. If you are a retailer or trade buyer
looking to source **wholesale products**, stocklots or clearance lines from UK suppliers and
**wholesalers**, select the Trade Buyers registration option. **UK based suppliers, wholesalers,
importers, distributors and manufacturers** looking to reach trade buyers worldwide can list their
business using our **premium services**. If your business is based abroad but supplies to the UK
please use the [international supplier registration option][157]. Premium suppliers, wholesalers,
importers and manufacturers benefit from increased exposure and numerous trading tools to increase
sales:

* Free access to all premium suppliers

## SERVICES**Our Services**

We mainly produce and export disposable medical consumables. In our company, we understand the
critical role that disposable medical consumables play in healthcare settings. These products are
essential for maintaining hygiene, preventing infections, and ensuring the well-being of patients
and healthcare professionals alike. 

Our commitment is to provide top-notch quality products that meet international standards. We are
proud to offer a wide range of disposable medical consumables that includes vacuum blood collection
tubes and needles, gloves, masks, gowns, storage vessels and much more. Each product is meticulously
designed, keeping in mind the specific needs and requirements of medical professionals.
[Read more ][139]

### Quality and Customized Solutions

International standard medical consumables for diverse healthcare professionals and facilities.

### Timely Delivery and Secure Transit

Efficient dispatch and safe delivery of critical medical supplies.

### Exceptional Customer Support

Dedicated team providing exceptional customer service for long-term relationships.

### Competitive Pricing and High Standards

Quality solutions at competitive prices with superior manufacturing standards.

In today's rapidly advancing medical industry, customization has become paramount. With the constant
need for innovative and personalized medical devices, choosing the right OEM&ODM (Original Equipment
Manufacturer & Original Design Manufacturer) partner is crucial. 
When it comes to Medical Consumables OEM&ODM, our company goes above and beyond to ensure customer
satisfaction. We understand that every medical establishment has unique requirements, and we are
committed to meeting those needs. Whether it's custom packaging, specific product materials, or even
branding, our company has the expertise and resources to deliver a fully-customized, turnkey
solution.

## SERVICES**Our Services**

We mainly produce and export disposable medical consumables. In our company, we understand the
critical role that disposable medical consumables play in healthcare settings. These products are
essential for maintaining hygiene, preventing infections, and ensuring the well-being of patients
and healthcare professionals alike. 

Our commitment is to provide top-notch quality products that meet international standards. We are
proud to offer a wide range of disposable medical consumables that includes vacuum blood collection
tubes and needles, gloves, masks, gowns, storage vessels and much more. Each product is meticulously
designed, keeping in mind the specific needs and requirements of medical professionals.

International standard medical consumables for diverse healthcare professionals and facilities.

### Competitive Pricing and High Standards

Quality solutions at competitive prices with superior manufacturing standards.

need for innovative and personalized medical devices, choosing the right OEM&ODM (Original Equipment
Manufacturer & Original Design Manufacturer) partner is crucial. 
When it comes to Medical Consumables OEM&ODM, our company goes above and beyond to ensure customer
satisfaction. We understand that every medical establishment has unique requirements, and we are
committed to meeting those needs. Whether it's custom packaging, specific product materials, or even
branding, our company has the expertise and resources to deliver a fully-customized, turnkey
solution.

# Enhancing patient care with high-quality medical devices

GBUK develops and distributes high-quality medical devices, supporting patients from the moment of
admission through to rehabilitation. With our specialist products and cutting-edge technologies,
healthcare professionals can treat patients safely and efficiently.

[Watch video][181]

[View all of our therapy areas][182]

* [
  
  ### Enteral Feeding Devices
  
  Safely delivering nutrition to patients, both in hospital and from the comfort of their own homes.
  ][183]
* [
  
  ### Patient Handling
  
  Reducing the risk of injury to patients and professionals with reliable, easy-to-use products.
  ][184]
* [
  
  ### Patient Handling – Community
  
  Explore our range of slings and patient handling equipment designed specifically for comfort and
  dignity in care.
  ][185]

  Specialist products that are widely used in operating theatres, high dependency units and
  emergency departments.
  ][186]

  ### Vascular
  
  Safe and effective vascular access with IV cannulas, syringes, needle-free solutions and more.
  ][187]
* [
  
  ### Wound Management
  
  Supporting and sustaining optimal wound care with patient comfort and clinical efficiency in mind.
  ][188]
* [
  
  ### Continence Care
  
  We are dedicated to supporting this essential sector with thoughtfully designed, high-quality
  solutions that enhance comfort, dignity and quality of life.
  ][189]

  ### Endourology
  
  Our endourology division offers advanced solutions designed to enhance patient outcomes, with

## Reliable Diagnostic Solutions for Modern Healthcare

Precision-engineered blood collection tubes and rapid test kits—trusted by labs, hospitals, and
diagnostic centers across the country.

[ Get in Touch ][14]
Why Choose Us

## Why Work with Us

#### Trusted Manufacturer of Precision Diagnostics

With a proven track record in producing high-quality vacuum and non-vacuum blood and urine
collection tubes, Marcela ensures accuracy, sterility, and safety in every product.

#### Comprehensive Product Range

From EDTA and clot activator tubes to rapid test kits for diseases like malaria, dengue, and
hepatitis, we offer end-to-end solutions for clinical diagnostics and laboratory testing.

#### Committed to Quality & Compliance

Our products are designed with global best practices, engineered stoppers, and tailored
preservatives—ensuring reliable performance and compatibility with all major laboratory protocols.

Our product range

### BLOOD COLLECTION TUBES

###### K2 & K3 EDTA

Marcela EDTA tubes are used in hematology while EDTA salts are widely used as anticoagulant in blood
collection tubes to cover the calcium ions of the blood, therefore preventing blood coagulation.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.58 (2)]

###### CLOT ACTIVATOR

Marcela serum tubes are used to collect serum sample for chemistry, serology, and immunology. The
tubes are coated with micronized silica particles which activate clotting when tubes are gently
inverted.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.58 (1)]

###### SODIUM FLUORIDE

Marcela EDTA/Sodium Fluoride & Sodium Fluoride/Potassium Oxa- late tubes are used in clinical
biochemistry and are suitable for the analy- sis of glucose concentration within 48 hours. Sodium
Fluoride is used as a glycolysis inhibitor, whereas the additive is used to prevent the enzymatic
action in the glycolytic pathway.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.58]

###### GEL CLOT ACTIVATOR

Marcela gel and clot activator is used for routine blood donor screening as well as for diagnosing
infectious diseases. The gel barrier at the bottom of the tube is used to separate the serum and the
blood clot as the gel barrier is moving upward to the serum clot during centrifugation.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.57 (2)]

###### LITHIUM HEPARIN

Marcela lithium heparin tubes are used in chemistry and special chemis- try testing. Heparin is the
recommended anticoagulant for many deter- minations using whole blood or plasma specimens. Tubes are
sprayed with dried sodium heparin additives.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.55]

###### SODIUM HEPARIN

Marcela tubes containing sodium heparin are used for the collection of heparinised plasma or whole
blood for special tests like endocrine, meta- bolic disorders and generally routine tests. The
additive is anticoagulant which prevents clotting or activation of thrombin. Should not be used for
coagulation or hematology testing.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.55]

###### SODIUM CITRATE

Marcela Citrate tubes (3.2% and 3.8%) are used for coagulation studies and contain buffered
sodiumvcitrate solution. The citrate tubes can also be used to obtain an accurate platelet count
through a special test procedure.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.57 (1)]
[ To Know More Download Brochure ][15]

## Urine Collection Tubes

###### URINE COLLECTION

Marcela urine collection tubes allow the collection, transportation, and analysis of urine specimen
quickly, safely, and hygienically. The tube is sterile, leak proof and safe to use. Made of
polypropylene

[test2 (2)]

Tubes are vacuum, with a pre-defined collection volume, as per the requirement. They should be used
within 30-60 minutes from collection.

Urine tubes are available with no additive for an immediate analysis carried out after collection
or, with 1% boric acid to maintain sample up to 12 hours without the need to refrigerate.

The preservative is important when the sample cannot be analyzed within 2 hours from collection.

What more we offer

## Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits

[test2 (3)]

### TYPHOID TEST KIT

For rapid qualitative detection of both Salmonella typhoid antibodies, IgG and IgM in human serum
and plasma. Only for In Vitro diagnostic use.

Pack Type: 50/Pieces Box

Carton Size: 40 Boxes

Category: TEST KIT

### MALARIA TEST KIT

Marcela Malaria Pf/Pv Ag is chromatographic immunoassay kit for rapid qualitative determination of
malaria infection using blood specimen.

Pack Type: 50/Pieces Box

Carton Size: 40 Boxes

Category: TEST KIT

preservatives—ensuring reliable performance and compatibility with all major laboratory protocols.

Marcela EDTA tubes are used in hematology while EDTA salts are widely used as anticoagulant in blood
collection tubes to cover the calcium ions of the blood, therefore preventing blood coagulation.

Marcela serum tubes are used to collect serum sample for chemistry, serology, and immunology. The

inverted.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.58 (1)]

Marcela EDTA/Sodium Fluoride & Sodium Fluoride/Potassium Oxa- late tubes are used in clinical
biochemistry and are suitable for the analy- sis of glucose concentration within 48 hours. Sodium
Fluoride is used as a glycolysis inhibitor, whereas the additive is used to prevent the enzymatic
action in the glycolytic pathway.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.58]

Marcela gel and clot activator is used for routine blood donor screening as well as for diagnosing
infectious diseases. The gel barrier at the bottom of the tube is used to separate the serum and the
blood clot as the gel barrier is moving upward to the serum clot during centrifugation.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.57 (2)]

Marcela lithium heparin tubes are used in chemistry and special chemis- try testing. Heparin is the
recommended anticoagulant for many deter- minations using whole blood or plasma specimens. Tubes are
sprayed with dried sodium heparin additives.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.55]

coagulation or hematology testing.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.55]

sodiumvcitrate solution. The citrate tubes can also be used to obtain an accurate platelet count
through a special test procedure.

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established

## **The Comprehensive Hematology Reference Platform**

Access structured reference articles, curated medical illustrations, and expert presentations
designed to streamline workflows and support complex differential diagnoses.

What is Hematology?

**Hematology**, also spelled *haematology*, is the branch of medicine concerned with the study of
the cause, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases related to blood. It involves treating
diseases that affect the production of blood and its components, such as blood cells, hemoglobin,
blood proteins, bone marrow, platelets, blood vessels, spleen, and the mechanism of coagulation.

[Learn more][13]

## **The Comprehensive Hematology Reference Platform**

Access structured reference articles, curated medical illustrations, and expert presentations
designed to streamline workflows and support complex differential diagnoses.

What is Hematology?

**Hematology**, also spelled *haematology*, is the branch of medicine concerned with the study of
the cause, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases related to blood. It involves treating
diseases that affect the production of blood and its components, such as blood cells, hemoglobin,
blood proteins, bone marrow, platelets, blood vessels, spleen, and the mechanism of coagulation.

[Learn more][13]

## What would you like to learn about today?

Select an option below to focus on a particular section of hematology.

#### [Red Blood Cells][14]

Learn why red blood cells are the primary oxygen carriers in the body and much more.

read more →

#### [White Blood Cells][15]

White blood cells are an important part of your immune system. Learn how they protect your body.

read more →

#### [Hemostasis Disorders][16]

Learn more about the common hemostasis disorders that affect many people around the world.

read more →

#### [Transfusion Medicine][17]

The branch of medicine that focuses on the transfusion of blood and blood components.

read more →

#### [Laboratory Protocols][18]

Learn more about the laboratory protocols that are being used in the labs today.

read more →

#### [Commentaries][19]

Read about the current industry news with the hematology sector.

read more →

the knowledge and insights needed to enhance clinical proficiency...

# Donation Basics

**Giving blood is as easy as 1, 2, 3.** Discover more about how to donate and share your power to
save lives.

[ About Blood

Blood is essential to life and there is no substitute. It cannot be made or manufactured. Generous
blood donors are the only source of blood for patients in need of a blood transfusion.

][82] [ Am I Eligible?

To prioritize the safety and well-being of both donors and patients, there are blood donation
eligibility requirements that donors must meet based on their intended donation method.

][83] [ Maximize Your Impact

Unlock the power of your blood type and save more lives when you Target Your Type®.

][84]

Blood is essential to life and there is no substitute. It cannot be made or manufactured. Generous
blood donors are the only source of blood for patients in need of a blood transfusion.

To prioritize the safety and well-being of both donors and patients, there are blood donation
eligibility requirements that donors must meet based on their intended donation method.

Unlock the power of your blood type and save more lives when you Target Your Type®.

[Donor donating blood at a OneBlood Donor Center]

## Get Signed Up & Signed In

Explore the features available in your portal, where you can access exciting rewards and review your
health history from the previous donation.  

[ Sign In Now ][85]

# Health History

Review your latest health summary results and gain valuable insights into your well-being.

[icon representing wellness checkup, heart with stethoscope ]

# Rewards

Enjoy the convenience of redeeming your rewards all in one place, where you can select from a
variety of eGift Cards.

[bonus bucks icon]

# My OneBlood Journey

Check out your OneBlood Journey, a program that will notify you when your donation is on its way to
a hospital.

[icon representing the journey of blood]

## I am OneBlood

Sharing diverse, remarkable, and inspiring real-life stories is what the I am OneBlood movement is
all about.

# The Matias Family

“Your donation could be the reason a family gets one more birthday, one more bedtime story, one more
chance to say, ‘I love you.’”

[Read the Story][86]
[ View Testimonials ][87]
[ Share Your Story ][88]

## Get Involved

Hosting a blood drive is fun, easy, and rewarding! From schools to businesses, religious
organizations to community gatherings, the Big Red Bus® can roll up just about anywhere there are
blood donors ready to save lives.

[Host a Drive][89]

### One Team.
### One Mission.

We are a progressive company that values diversity, drive, and dedication. We are always looking for
team members to help fulfill our lifesaving mission.

## Your Trusted Mobile Partner

OnGo Diagnostics is a mobile phlebotomy service , offering in-home blood collection, urine drug
screens, and specimen pick-up for clients who value comfort, privacy, and reliability. Robin Green,
the founder and head phlebotomist, brings more than 20 years of medical experience and a deep-rooted
passion for caring for others. Robin began working in hospital settings before running a home care
agency, later teaching phlebotomy as an instructor. Motivated by a desire to make healthcare more
accessible, Robin established OnGo Diagnostics in 2020 - enabling clients to receive high-quality
lab services delivered by a skilled, friendly professional. Every appointment reflects a personal
touch, focused on the emotional and practical needs of each person, whether helping someone manage
diabetes, heart disease, or simply easing the stress of routine testing. Clients know they are in
safe and caring hands.

## Why Choose OnGo Diagnostics

### Convenience

Lab work happens on your terms, not the hospital's. OnGo Diagnostics saves clients from the trouble
of waiting rooms, long drives, or juggling busy schedules. Services are available directly at your
home or location of choice in Gainesville and nearby areas, supporting those with mobility or health
challenges.

### Compassion

Your comfort comes first in every interaction. With a caring and patient-centered approach, OnGo
Diagnostics understands medical visits can feel stressful or overwhelming. Friendly communication, a
gentle manner, and personalized support make each step as reassuring as possible - especially for
those managing chronic conditions.

### Affordability

Booking should be simple, and paying should be secure. OnGo Diagnostics offers instant online
scheduling, transparent pricing, and safe online payment options - all from your own device. Live
chat support and flexible bookings work around family and work commitments, so you stay in control.

seasoned, compassionate specialist, this service puts your comfort first. Clients of all ages and
health backgrounds benefit from flexible, 24/7 scheduling, easy online booking, and real-time direct
support. Each visit is guided by genuine concern, helping you stay healthy without the stress of
leaving home. Experience mobile lab testing designed for your needs - book an appointment, explore
pricing, or contact the team today.

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation
][162]

## Partners for medicine and research

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

[Highlight SMF-Pro-Website 1024x768px 0626]

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation

## Partners for medicine and research

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

The function and key points of use of free DNA preservation solution
2026-07-22
Free DNA preservation solution is a liquid reagent specifically used to preserve free DNA in blood
and other samples. In the field of liquid biopsy, free DNA is an important detection object, and its
integrity directly affects the reliability of subsequent genetic testing results. The function of
free DNA preservation solution is to protect DNA molecules from degradation and contamination during
the period from sample collection to detection, maintaining their concentration and structure in
their original state. Design logic and core components of preservation solution Free DNA
preservation solution is a multi optimized protective system designed to maintain the structural
integrity of free DNA at its original concentration. To achieve this goal, preservation solutions
typically contain several key components. Buffer solution is the basic component of preservation
solution, which is responsible for maintaining the pH stability of the entire system. DNA molecules
are prone to deprotonation or hydrolysis reactions in acidic or alkaline environments, and the
addition of buffer can effectively resist pH fluctuations caused by the sample itself or external
environment. Chelating agents are another important component, and EDTA is the most common choice
among them. There are naturally occurring nucleases in blood samples, and the activity of these
enzymes often depends on metal ions such as magnesium ions as cofactors. EDTA chelates these metal
ions, depriving nucleases of the auxiliary conditions required for their activity, thereby
inhibiting the degradation process of DNA. Protease inhibitors also have a place in the preservation
solution. Proteases in the sample may degrade proteins that bind to DNA, indirectly affecting the
stability of DNA molecules. Adding protease inhibitors helps maintain the binding state between DNA
and proteins, providing indirect protection for DNA. In some formulations, polymerase inhibitors are
also added to prevent the consumption or alteration of DNA templates by non-specific nucleic acid
amplification reactions that may exist in the sample. The core function of preservation solution
Free DNA preservation solution achieves protection of free DNA through multiple mechanisms.
Inhibiting nuclease activity is one of the most direct pathways. After blood collection, nucleases
that were originally separated from blood cells will be released through cellular metabolism or come
into contact with free DNA. If not inhibited, nucleases will continue to cleave DNA molecules,
resulting in a decrease or even disappearance of the target fragment concentration. The chelating
agents and protease inhibitors in the preservation solution jointly reduce the activity of
nucleases, providing a relatively safe chemical environment for DNA. The convenience brought by room
temperature storage Traditionally, the preservation of free DNA relies on low-temperature freezing,
and samples need to be placed in an environment of minus 20 degrees Celsius or even minus 80 degrees
Celsius as soon as possible after collection. Although this method is effective, it requires a large
investment in cold chain equipment, strict transportation conditions, and complex operational
procedures. Free DNA preservation solution allows samples to be stored at room temperature for
several weeks or even longer without significant degradation. This feature greatly simplifies the
process of sample collection, transportation, and temporary storage, especially suitable for
application scenarios in multi center clinical trials and primary healthcare institutions.
Precautions during use Free DNA storage solution should be stored in a dark and cool place, avoiding
high temperatures and direct sunlight. It should not be stored frozen, as freezing may cause certain
components in the storage solution to precipitate or denature, affecting its protective effect. The
storage solution is designed for one-time use, and once mixed with the sample, it should not be
reused even if it is not completely used to prevent cross contamination. Before use, carefully read
the product manual and operate according to the recommended addition ratio and mixing method. For
experimental plans with special requirements, pre experiments can be conducted to verify the
compatibility of the preservation solution with the subsequent detection system. Free DNA
preservation solution provides an efficient tool for sample management in liquid biopsy. The free
DNA preservation solution produced by Hubei Xindesheng Material Technology Co., Ltd. is suitable for
the preservation and transportation of free DNA in blood samples, and can provide a stable sample
basis for subsequent genetic testing.

The function and key points of use of free DNA preservation solution
2026-07-22
Free DNA preservation solution is a liquid reagent specifically used to preserve free DNA in blood
and other samples. In the field of liquid biopsy, free DNA is an important detection object, and its
integrity directly affects the reliability of subsequent genetic testing results. The function of
free DNA preservation solution is to protect DNA molecules from degradation and contamination during
the period from sample collection to detection, maintaining their concentration and structure in
their original state. Design logic and core components of preservation solution Free DNA
preservation solution is a multi optimized protective system designed to maintain the structural
integrity of free DNA at its original concentration. To achieve this goal, preservation solutions
typically contain several key components. Buffer solution is the basic component of preservation
solution, which is responsible for maintaining the pH stability of the entire system. DNA molecules
are prone to deprotonation or hydrolysis reactions in acidic or alkaline environments, and the
addition of buffer can effectively resist pH fluctuations caused by the sample itself or external
environment. Chelating agents are another important component, and EDTA is the most common choice
among them. There are naturally occurring nucleases in blood samples, and the activity of these
enzymes often depends on metal ions such as magnesium ions as cofactors. EDTA chelates these metal
ions, depriving nucleases of the auxiliary conditions required for their activity, thereby
inhibiting the degradation process of DNA. Protease inhibitors also have a place in the preservation
solution. Proteases in the sample may degrade proteins that bind to DNA, indirectly affecting the
stability of DNA molecules. Adding protease inhibitors helps maintain the binding state between DNA
and proteins, providing indirect protection for DNA. In some formulations, polymerase inhibitors are
also added to prevent the consumption or alteration of DNA templates by non-specific nucleic acid
amplification reactions that may exist in the sample. The core function of preservation solution
Free DNA preservation solution achieves protection of free DNA through multiple mechanisms.
Inhibiting nuclease activity is one of the most direct pathways. After blood collection, nucleases
that were originally separated from blood cells will be released through cellular metabolism or come
into contact with free DNA. If not inhibited, nucleases will continue to cleave DNA molecules,
resulting in a decrease or even disappearance of the target fragment concentration. The chelating
agents and protease inhibitors in the preservation solution jointly reduce the activity of
nucleases, providing a relatively safe chemical environment for DNA. The convenience brought by room
temperature storage Traditionally, the preservation of free DNA relies on low-temperature freezing,
and samples need to be placed in an environment of minus 20 degrees Celsius or even minus 80 degrees
Celsius as soon as possible after collection. Although this method is effective, it requires a large
investment in cold chain equipment, strict transportation conditions, and complex operational
procedures. Free DNA preservation solution allows samples to be stored at room temperature for
several weeks or even longer without significant degradation. This feature greatly simplifies the
process of sample collection, transportation, and temporary storage, especially suitable for
application scenarios in multi center clinical trials and primary healthcare institutions.
Precautions during use Free DNA storage solution should be stored in a dark and cool place, avoiding
high temperatures and direct sunlight. It should not be stored frozen, as freezing may cause certain
components in the storage solution to precipitate or denature, affecting its protective effect. The
storage solution is designed for one-time use, and once mixed with the sample, it should not be
reused even if it is not completely used to prevent cross contamination. Before use, carefully read
the product manual and operate according to the recommended addition ratio and mixing method. For
experimental plans with special requirements, pre experiments can be conducted to verify the
compatibility of the preservation solution with the subsequent detection system. Free DNA
preservation solution provides an efficient tool for sample management in liquid biopsy. The free
DNA preservation solution produced by Hubei Xindesheng Material Technology Co., Ltd. is suitable for
the preservation and transportation of free DNA in blood samples, and can provide a stable sample
basis for subsequent genetic testing.
